summary.text: Mike Zimmer is a Democratic Iowa state senator who has represented District 35 since February 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a small business owner and educator.

paragraphs.text: Mike Zimmer earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Northern Iowa and a graduate degree from the University of Iowa, and his career experience includes working as a small business owner and educator.
He previously served on the Central DeWitt School District board as an at-large member.
Zimmer assumed office in the Iowa State Senate on February 10, 2025, succeeding Chris Cournoyer, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
